OAT-06/S10.title: Per-day row: wrong-zone device and across the device's midnight (an2-oat06-s10-daily R3-R4)
OAT-06/S10.detail: R3: a device in Pacific/Kiritimati 3 days ahead files its rows under its own day (2026-10-23) instead of the server's 2026-10-20. R4: an encounter opened before the device's midnight and completed after it is filed over two days, untimed. completeEncounter is server-side now but still takes day: localDay() from the device (PostRoundTab.tsx:99-105). R1-R2 (Generate) not re-run locally.
